Des acrobates de foire qui volent en ple: Fairground acrobats who steal mid-flip. They leap, grab the item on the way and throw it right back at the target: every stolen item feeds the combo. A spectacular duo that plays with the enemy's inventory
Des agents du chaos qui piochent dans un: Agents of chaos who draw from a deck that is not theirs. Heist: look at cards from a class missing from the squad and keep one, cheaper. Copies, items stripped for energy, improvised plans: never the same trick twice
Des agents du port qui taxent tout ce qu: Harbor officers who tax everything that passes. Every item card kept in stock becomes a shield, every enemy in contact must hand over what it carries or pay for it. Steal, stockpile, and hold the line behind a mountain of seized goods
Des artilleurs camouflés qui transformen: Camouflaged gunners who turn the brush into a firing range. Lures, tripwire mines, turrets and ballistas: traps explode, turrets mark, and enemies walk exactly where they are expected
Des artisans pour qui le geste compte pl: Craftsmen for whom the gesture matters more than inspiration. Every technical gesture sharpens the tool: a card that gains a level for the fight, a sketch that explodes, a tempo that rises with every barrel that blows. They build their turn piece by piece, like tuning a machine
Des braconniers pour qui chaque piège es: Poachers for whom every trap is one more pocket. Snares, nets and golden baits: the prey is rooted and drops its item into the hero's hand. Traps bring in gold, items and damage all at once
Des chasseurs qui lisent le monstre avan: Hunters who read the monster before they strike. Scouting, rolling, a well-timed dodge, then the attack window: this duo waits, learns the pattern and hits hard when the opening comes. Finishing a great prey earns a trophy
Des chasseurs qui mettent un prix sur ch: Hunters who put a price on every head. A marked target becomes a bounty: doubled poison, gold on the line, energy back when it falls. Spot, trap, and wait for the right moment to cash the contract
Des collectionneurs pour qui un objet va: Collectors for whom an item is worth a spell. They craft vials, dismantle their finds for damage and make their finest item act twice. The fuller the stock, the richer the hand
Des combattants aux poings chargés de po: Fighters with powder-packed fists. Every melee blow lights a fuse: barrels dropped at the enemy's feet, gauntlets that knock back, an explosion on the third hit of the turn. A brutal duo that turns melee into demolition
Des coureurs des rives qui traquent à ma: Riverbank runners who hunt bare-handed. Sweeps, chokeholds and predator leaps: the prey is rooted, then hit harder because it can no longer flee. Mobile and wild, this duo hunts up close
Des devins-archers qui voient le coup av: Seer-archers who see the shot before they loose it. They mark, read omens, carve runes and fire at exact range to trigger their bonuses. Each turn sets up the next: when the arrow flies, the outcome is already written
Des diaristes qui relisent leurs pages p: Diarists who reread their pages to replay what worked. Discard recalled to hand, played cards coming back, draws paid in HP: this duo lives on its cycles, relapse and recovery, and finds its strength in repetition
Des ferrailleurs pour qui tout se recycl: Scrappers for whom everything is recycled: an item becomes a barrel, a barrel becomes an item. They dismantle, craft, recharge and set up salvage turrets. The stock never empties, it only changes shape
Des gardes du corps qui cognent avec leu: Bodyguards who hit with their armor: it is not a shelter but a stockpile of blows. Every strike of the turn thickens the guard, then the guard comes back as damage: iron palm, rock stance, a rush toward an ally. The longer the fight, the harder this hero hits

Des gardes forestiers qui choisissent le: Wardens who pick the ground before the battle. They lay traps, stakes and palisades, then shove the prey straight in: a trap that bites twice, a marked enemy, rising armor. The fight is won on the map before it is won on HP
Warriors who seek the wound. Every HP lost stokes their rage: their blows grow with their wounds, they cut themselves to draw, strike twice at death's door and answer blood with blood. Their Berserk turns every hit taken into damage for the rest of the fight. This duo heals poorly and knows it: it wins by bleeding, so let it bleed

Des lames qui écoutent les ombres. Pioch: Blades that listen to the shadows. Drawing more means striking more: every extra card feeds an attack, a doubling poison, an ally appearing behind the target. Quiet, fragile, but every well-drawn turn ends in a massacre
Des mages-forgerons qui paient plus cher: Forge-mages who pay more to burn everything. Overload spreads a spell to every enemy, barrels blow in chains and braziers light up across the field. This duo burns its energy at once to turn the arena into a furnace
Des prêtres en armure qui soignent au-de: Armored priests who heal beyond need, because nothing is wasted: overhealing turns into armor, doubled. They bless, raise Springs under their feet and strike from afar with the steel they have piled up. Slow to start, this duo becomes a wall no one gets through
Des saboteurs qui frappent dans le dos e: Saboteurs who stab in the back and leave a gift behind. Primers, smoke, charges stuck to the enemy: the dagger is only the start, the nearby barrel finishes the job. Positioning matters as much as the blade
Des sabreurs qui ne tirent la lame qu'un: Swordsmen who draw the blade only once. Pommel to open, phantom step to reposition, mirror blade to punish the enemy who strikes, a shout that pushes it back in the initiative, a thousand cuts when the guard opens. Their Iai triples the first hit of the turn. It all happens in the window: too early, you're exposed; too late, you're dead

Des sages pour qui chaque coup porté est: Sages for whom every blow dealt is healing given. They strike in melee and life flows to the most wounded ally; they meditate, draw and heal the whole group. A duo that keeps a squad standing without ever stopping the attack
Des sapeurs qui transforment la tranchée: Sappers who turn the trench into a trap. Sandbags, barrels, cracked pillars and rams: armor takes the first hit, powder answers the second. Set the stage, charge the enemy into a barrel, and the blast does the rest
